landmarks.what: pins electron-updater/electron-builder/@electron/asar exactly and installs both darwin libsql arches for a universal build

findings.text: package.json bumps version 0.1.4 -> 0.1.5, which the t-1 description does not mention. It fits the release_pipeline/device_uat decisions (tag MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH must equal package.json; v0.1.5 tags), but it is an unplanned change in this task.

yamlSubList (scripts/build-desktop.spec.ts) keeps column-0 '#' comment lines inside the block when computing the minimum indent. One such comment under supportedArchitectures makes the indent 0, so the sub-keys are never matched and the test fails falsely on a valid config.
The darwin libsql test checks more than resolution: it also asserts index.node exists next to each @libsql/darwin-* manifest, which is stronger than the test_contract requires.
